title: Silent Crash of AAPS
symptom: AAPS silently crashes, stopping all activity, and the pod does not fallback to the basal profile until the user checks the phone hours later, causing blood glucose to rise.
evidence_quote: AAPS has crash silently. The first screenshot shows around 3pm30 (17 january 2021) that AAPS stops everything and the most problematic thing is that the pod doesn't fallback on my basal profile until I check my phone around 6pm.
